qualification.details: Eligibility follows the NMC Teachers Eligibility Qualifications (TEQ) guidelines 2025 and their latest amendments (National Medical Commission, Notification F.No.N-P051(12)/18/2024-PGMEB-MNC). The upper age limit for both posts is up to 70 years, as on 20 November 2026. Retired faculty and doctors from private medical colleges, Institutes of National Importance and other Government medical colleges within the country may apply as per the eligibility for each post. | (a)(i) Associate Professor in the subject for three years in a recognised medical institution; or (ii) Specialist Medical Officer of the Armed Forces with at least three years of experience as Associate Professor in the relevant speciality in a teaching hospital of the Armed Forces; and (b)(i) at least two research publications after becoming Associate Professor, among the first three authors; (ii) Basic Course in Biomedical Research from a recognised medical institution completed; and (iii) Basic Course in Medical Education required, provided the broad specialty subject is covered under undergraduate training. Note 1: For Aviation Medicine and Marine Medicine, two years as Flying Squadron (Aviation) and two years in a Diving and Escape Training School (Marine Medicine) are considered equivalent to one year of teaching experience as Associate Professor. Note 2: A Senior Consultant with three years of experience as post graduate teacher of broad specialty or super specialty subject in a National Board of Examination in Medical Sciences recognised Government medical institute is eligible to become Professor in the concerned specialty. Total years as post graduate teacher in such an institute count as experience as Professor. | (a)(i) Assistant Professor in the subject for four years in a recognised medical institution, or five years for those appointed directly as Assistant Professor in a Government medical institution; or (ii) Specialist Medical Officer of the Armed Forces with at least five years of clinical experience in the relevant specialty after the recognised Postgraduate qualification, of which at least three years as Assistant Professor in a teaching hospital of the Armed Forces; and (b)(i) at least two research publications after becoming Assistant Professor, among the first three authors; (ii) Basic Course in Biomedical Research from a recognised medical institution designated by the Commission; and (iii) Basic Course in Medical Education required, provided the broad specialty subject is covered under undergraduate training. Note: A non-teaching Consultant, Specialist or Medical Officer with a postgraduate medical degree and ten years of experience in at least a 220 bedded Government hospital is eligible to become Associate Professor of that broad specialty. On such appointment, the Basic Course in Medical Education and the Basic Course in Biomedical Research must be completed within two years. | Candidates must hold updated NMC/State Medical Council registration covering all post-MBBS/MD/MS qualifications. Without it, they must produce "Applied for document(s)" at the interview; otherwise they may not be interviewed or their result may be withheld. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

salary_details.pay_scale: Professor Rs. 3,20,000; Associate Professor Rs. 2,60,000 (monthly fixed remuneration, without any added allowance)

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted by email only. Eligible candidates who wish to attend the interview must submit the scanned application form (Annexure-I) with supporting documents to [email protected] by 05:00 PM on 20 November 2026.
Fill in the application form given as Annexure-I in the notice and affix a self-photograph.
Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below.
Combine the form and all documents into one single PDF. Multiple submissions will not be considered.
Email the PDF to [email protected] with the subject line: Application for the Position of Professor and Associate Professor at Shillong Medical College, Shillong.
Send it so that it reaches by 05:00 PM on 20 November 2026.
Submit a separate application for each post, in the prescribed format only; other formats or incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.

Applicants already employed in Central/State Government, autonomous institutions, statutory organisations or PSUs under Central/State Governments should route applications through proper channel. If that is not immediately available, a copy of "Applied for NOC" is to be submitted at the interview. The application form asks for post and department applied for, personal details, educational qualifications, medical council registration, present designation, academic records, previous teaching experience, number of publications, and completion of the Medical Education and Biomedical Research courses.

Selection is on the basis of academic credentials and performance in the interview before the Selection Board. The interview mode is offline. Candidates will be told by email of any additional documents needed and of the interview date at least 7 days before the scheduled date. Dates of interview for later cut-off applicants under the rolling advertisement will be notified in due course. Screening, communication, interviews and recruitment will be conducted in phases, depending on availability of experts, receipt of complete documents and the requirements of the position. Results will be displayed on https://shillongmedicalcollege.co.in and https://meghealth.gov.in, and the offer of appointment will be sent by email.

content_sections.heading: About Shillong Medical College
content_sections.text: Shillong Medical College is a Government of Meghalaya institution under the Health & Family Welfare Department, located at Pasteur Hills, Lawmali Road, Shillong, Meghalaya – 793001. The notice invites applications for Professor and Associate Professor posts on a contractual basis. The Director, Shillong Medical College, is the authority named in the notice for queries and for any cancellation or postponement of the process.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 7 Professor posts and 4 Associate Professor posts, one in each department shown. Vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease as per the actual requirement for teaching and patient care. The notice prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The notice states that the maximum tenure is till 70 years of age or the years of contract mentioned in the ToR, whichever is earlier, provided other rules and regulations are satisfied. The posts are full-time and private practice of any kind is strictly prohibited. Selected candidates receive an appointment letter. Appointment is subject to being declared medically fit by the Medical Board constituted, and to verification of documents, declaration and antecedents. No TA/DA is provided for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 11 vacancies: 7 for Professor and 4 for Associate Professor. They are provisional and may increase or decrease as per actual requirement.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for SMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 20 November 2026, 5:00 PM, for emailing the application. It is the cut-off date of this rolling advertisement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Professor and Associate Professor at SMC?
faq.answer: Both posts require MD/MS/DNB in the concerned subject. Professor needs three years as Associate Professor, and Associate Professor needs four years as Assistant Professor (five years if directly appointed in a Government institution), with research publications as per NMC TEQ 2025.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for SMC Professor posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is up to 70 years as on 20 November 2026 for both Professor and Associate Professor.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for SMC Professor and Associate Professor?
faq.answer: Professor gets Rs. 3,20,000 and Associate Professor gets Rs. 2,60,000 as monthly fixed remuneration, without any added allowance.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for SMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email the scanned Annexure-I form with self-attested documents as one PDF to [email protected], with the subject "Application for the Position of Professor and Associate Professor at Shillong Medical College, Shillong".

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on academic credentials and performance in the interview before the Selection Board. The interview is offline.

faq.question: Q8. Is the SMC Professor job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the posts are contractual. The maximum tenure is 7 (4+3) years or 70 years of age, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Can retired doctors apply?
faq.answer: Yes, retired faculty and doctors from private medical colleges, Institutes of National Importance and other Government medical colleges within the country may apply as per the eligibility for each post.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.
